    batches = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(items):
        batch = []
        while i < len(items) and (len(batch) < 3 or sum(len(item) for item in batch) < 4):
            batch.append(items[i])
            i += 1
        batches.append(batch)
    return batches

# Apply the custom function
